featured.aria: Featured project Villa Mirador: try the live demo
featured.title: Villa Mirador: the full demo from 1 USD
featured.body: Choose how many shares to buy (free, with Binance or with your wallet), the house earns a profit and you watch it reach your wallet step by step, with narration.

chain.title: The blockchain records everything
chain.intro: Every movement is a transaction stored in a block, chained to the previous one. No one can delete or change it. Tap a block to see the proof read straight from the network ({{network}}).
chain.empty: Blocks appear here as soon as the demo starts.
chain.noRpc: There’s no network access to read the proof.
chain.reading: Reading the proof from the network…
chain.readFailed: The transaction couldn’t be read from the network. Try again.

s0.title: This is how investing in a property works
s0.body: Villa Mirador is a rental house split into 5 shares of 1 USD. Whoever holds a share collects 1/5 of what the house earns. You choose how many shares to buy and follow the money on the map.

s1.title: You put in the money
s1.bodyReadyOne: Your money is now on the platform. On the map it moves from the left to your wallet (W1).
s1.bodyReadyMany: Your money is now on the platform. On the map it moves from the left to your {{count}} wallets.
s1.bodyAwaiting: Send the payment with these details. As soon as it arrives, the demo continues on its own.
s1.bodyChoose: Choose how many shares you want and how to pay. If you just want to watch, choose “Watch the free demo”.

s2.title: All 5 shares are bought
s2.bodyShared: Your money buys your {{parts}} ({{range}}). {{others}} buy the rest. Every purchase is recorded on the blockchain.
s2.bodyAll: Your 5 USD buy all 5 shares: you own 100% of the house. Every purchase is recorded on the blockchain.

s3.title: The house earns a profit
s3.bodyDone: {{story}} The company put 5 USD of profit into the contract to distribute.
s3.bodyChoose: A month has passed. Choose what happened at the villa and tap “Distribute the profit”. You play the company that owns the project.

s4.title: The contract distributes on its own
s4.body: 5 USD ÷ 5 shares = 1 USD per share. Each owner collects according to what they hold: you get {{mine}} USD. No one does the math by hand.

s5.title: Your profit reaches your wallet
s5.body: {{lead}} what they collected. {{others}}Check your balance above.

s6.title: Here’s what happened
s6.put: You put in {{mine}} USD → you bought {{parts}} of 5 ({{pct}}% of the house).
s6.earned: The house earned 5 USD ({{hito}}) → you got {{mine}} USD.
s6.allParts: With all 5 shares you would have got everything: 5 USD.
